column1: # Digimon Story: Time Stranger on Android (Unreal Engine 4 on SDK 20.5.21, update 1.2.2 with its 14 DLC; keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# Brought up on a Poco F5 (Snapdragon 7+ Gen 2, Adreno 725) from Termux, with the whole port built on the phone (docs/TERMUX_TOOLCHAIN_COMPATIBILITY.md).
# The shaders sit in MVGL archives and in main; the shader split reads them (19,932 shaders, 2026-11-23). On 2026-11-23 it played into the game and held 30 fps in handheld
# and in docked mode, in a crowded area, with Mesa's Turnip (vulkan_driver below: Turnip 26.99.99, Mesa 27.0.0-devel) and no GPU turbo. The system Vulkan driver gives about
# 20 fps there even with DM_GPU_TURBO=1. The env rows are what holds 30 fps: a build installed without DM_NVN_ACQ_REPLAYED=0 and DM_PIN_REPLAY=prime ran about 20 fps with
# the same driver (not measured one at a time); the port writes the profile's env rows into the app's env.txt, so a switch missing here is missing on the device.
# Only a short session, including one crowded area, was played, in both modes, so the status stays wip until more of the game has been tested.
